summary: Linked-list destructor (called by DestroyUIWidgetHierarchy 004b5a30). Walks the list from head this+0x0 until the node pointer is null. For each node whose node+0x8 free-data flag is set, when the node data pointer (node+0x0) and its first dword are non-null, iterates over the refcounted 884-byte-strided elements calling EmptyStub_0170 per element, then frees the refcount block and the data allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf; the node itself is always freed. Finally zeroes the four list fields this+0x0 through this+0xC and returns 0.

local_names.this: list container: head at +0x0, tail at +0x4, current at +0x8, node count at +0xC
local_names.v2: current node pointer during the walk; also carries the next-node pointer read from node+0x4
local_names.v3: node being processed (data pointer at node+0x0, free-data flag at node+0x8, next at node+0x4)
local_names.v6: first dword of the data block, used to reach the refcount block
local_names.v7: refcount block base, computed as data[0] - 4
local_names.v8: element pointer advanced by the 884-byte stride over the refcounted array

operations.description: Walk the linked list starting at the head this+0x0 while the current node pointer is non-null; the next node is read from node+0x4.
Guard: process the node's data only when the free-data flag at node+0x8 is non-zero.
Guard: the node data pointer at node+0x0 is non-null and its first dword (data[0]) is non-null before the refcounted block is processed.
Compute the refcount block base v7 = data[0] - 4 and the element start v8 = data[0] + 884 * refcount, where the refcount is read from the dword at data[0] - 4.
do-while loop over the refcount value: for each element decrement v8 by the 884-byte stride and call EmptyStub_0170, repeating while the counter is positive.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v7) to release the refcount block, and FreeWrapper_7bcf(v5) to release the node data allocation.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3) to free the node itself on every iteration.
After the walk, zero the four list fields this+0x0, this+0x4, this+0x8 and this+0xC.
